item.title: Evening Weather for Saturday, September 05
item.description: Good evening! It's the weekend. No school today! Here is your weather report for Saturday, September 5. It's Saturday, a whole day to do what you like. Today in Shanghai, it will be drizzly. It will reach 31 degrees, and drop down to 24 degrees. There is a 35 percent chance of rain. It's going to be hot. Drink lots of water and wear a hat! It's a puddle day! Let's put on our wellies and see how many puddles we can jump in. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be a little bit rainy, reaching 30 degrees. A question for you: what song would you like to hear today? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
